command:
J=/workspace/jobs/hb-test-20261001
echo "== poll long job"; date -u; echo "tmux:"; tmux ls 2>&1; echo "started=$(cat $J/started)"; echo "ended=$(cat $J/ended 2>/dev/null || echo running)"; echo "exit_code=$(cat $J/exit_code 2>/dev/null || echo none)"; echo "DONE=$(cat $J/DONE 2>/dev/null || echo no)"; echo "beats=$(wc -l < $J/heartbeat.log)"; head -2 $J/heartbeat.log; tail -2 $J/heartbeat.log
echo "== zombies in container view"; ps -eo stat= | grep -c '^Z' || true; cat /proc/loadavg
